periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axes of the ovoid eye patches are oriented at approximately 45-degree angles toward the muzzle relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: The eye patches exhibit an elongated oval shape with a vertical height exceeding the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: The patches show a distinct downward taper with the inferior margin appearing narrower and more pointed than the rounded superior margin.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band across the lateral shoulders and upper torso occupies approximately 35% of the visible vertical torso span.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The ears are widely set, with a gap approximately 1.5 times the width of an individual pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The tops of the ears exhibit a smooth, high-curvature semicircular profile.

other_distinctive_markers: The abdominal fur shows significant matting and yellowish-brown discoloration in contrast to the high-contrast white cranial fur.
